method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Minimum Conditions of Employment Act 1993 (WA), consolidated text at legislation.wa.gov.au (law_a516, mrdoc_48248, retrieved 7 September 2026; amendments up to No. 43 of 2024), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_48248.txt. No regulations used; the State Wage order rates (IR Act s 50A) are inputs.

checks.command: l4 run mce-employee.l4 ; l4 run mce-cases-employee.l4 ; l4 run mce-qa.l4 ; l4 run mce-qa-cases.l4 ; l4 check mce-qa.l4
checks.result: 227 assertions satisfied (43 baseline + 184 Q&A layer), 0 errors, 0 warnings in all four files; l4 check mce-qa.l4 succeeds (2026-11-06)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Whether the Act reaches me (s 3 employee via IR Act ss 7(1), 7A; s 5; s 6A; the Fair Work Act s 26 exclusion asked as a fact), no contracting out (s 5), cashing out annual leave (s 8), maximum hours (s 9A), minimum rates of pay (ss 10-14), personal leave (ss 20, 20A, 21), annual leave (ss 23-26), bereavement leave (s 27), public holidays (ss 30, 31), unpaid family and domestic violence leave (ss 39B, 39C), redundancy information and job-interview leave (ss 40, 41, 43). Out: disability and Supported Wage (ss 15-17), Part 3A pay methods, leave pay rates (ss 18-18B), compensated employees, ss 32-33, proof and confidentiality, flexible working (Part 4A), transitional Parts, enforcement and regulations.
seat: the employee (a State system employee; the Act does not reach an employee of a national system employer)
lives: c040 Chloe: graduate program at Ironbark Logistics -- does this Act apply to me? (no: national system employer)
